claim: A Hidden Markov Model (HMM) constructed as surrogate model of a large language model (LLM) can be used to generate outputs that are guaranteed to adhere to precisely formalized logical constraints, such that the HMM approximation enables computing a constrained conditional probability distribution under which generation is restricted to sequences accepted by a formal constraint representation (for example, a deterministic finite automaton (DFA)), ensuring constraint satisfaction by construction, which leads to a guarantee that holds independent of the surrogate model’s fidelity, while the extent to which the resulting outputs reflect the original large language model depends on how accurately the surrogate model represents it.

experiment_recipes.goal: Validate that the formal constraint representation is exact, satisfiable, and non-trivial
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Construct at least 200 satisfiable and 50 deliberately unsatisfiable token-level logical constraint instances from CommonGen concepts using positive keyword, negative keyword, and ordering constraints. Pass iff an independent exhaustive validator and the formal constraint representation agree on acceptance for 100% of all enumerated sequences up to length 8 over the top-64 token vocabulary; every satisfiable instance has at least one accepted witness; every deliberately unsatisfiable instance has zero accepted witnesses; and at least 90% of satisfiable instances have unconstrained LLM sample acceptance strictly between 5% and 95%. Any disagreement, empty satisfiable instance, nonempty unsatisfiable instance, or mostly trivial acceptance rates refutes this prerequisite.
constraints_not_enforced: Computation of a constrained conditional probability distribution
Guaranteed constrained generation from the HMM
experiment_recipes.rationale: Before testing constrained generation, the verifier must establish that the symbolic constraint object exactly represents the intended logical constraints and that the constraints are neither impossible nor vacuous.

experiment_recipes.goal: Validate that the fitted HMM is a measurable surrogate of the LLM
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Fit the HMM to next-token behavior of the LLM on CommonGen prompts and held-out LLM-sampled continuations using the same tokenizer. Pass iff on a held-out set of at least 10000 tokens, the HMM cross-entropy on LLM-sampled continuations is no more than 1.0 nat/token worse than the LLM's own negative log-likelihood on those same continuations, and HMM perplexity is finite for 100% of held-out continuations. If the gap exceeds 1.0 nat/token or any held-out continuation has zero HMM probability, the HMM is not validated as a surrogate for this claim.
constraints_not_enforced: Restriction of generation to accepted sequences
depends_on: Validate that the formal constraint representation is exact, satisfiable, and non-trivial
experiment_recipes.rationale: The claim presupposes an HMM constructed as a surrogate model of an LLM; this apparatus check verifies that the HMM approximates the LLM distribution before testing constrained generation.

experiment_recipes.goal: Verify exact computation of the HMM constrained conditional probability distribution
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: For at least 100 satisfiable constraint instances from the gate, form the product of the HMM and the formal constraint representation and compute the conditional distribution over accepted sequences. For bounded tests with max length 12 and top-64 token vocabulary, also brute-force enumerate all sequences. Pass iff for every instance the product normalizer is positive, total conditional probability over accepted sequences equals 1 within absolute error 1e-10, every sequence assigned nonzero conditional probability is accepted by the validator, every rejected sequence has conditional probability exactly 0, and the maximum absolute probability difference from brute-force enumeration is at most 1e-8. Any violation refutes the claim that the HMM enables computing the constrained conditional distribution.
constraints_not_enforced: Approximation quality to the original LLM beyond the validated HMM surrogate
Logical constraints not expressible by the tested formal representation
depends_on: Validate that the formal constraint representation is exact, satisfiable, and non-trivial
Validate that the fitted HMM is a measurable surrogate of the LLM
experiment_recipes.rationale: The central mathematical assertion is that conditioning the HMM on the formal language yields a computable probability distribution whose support is exactly the accepted set; bounded enumeration gives an exact oracle check.

experiment_recipes.goal: Verify that generated HMM outputs are guaranteed to satisfy the formal constraints
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Using the product HMM from the constrained conditional distribution test, generate at least 10000 continuations across the satisfiable constraint instances. Also statically inspect the product sampler's support graph. Pass iff the support graph contains no path that can emit an end-of-sequence output from a non-accepting constraint state, and 10000 out of 10000 generated continuations are accepted by the independent validator. A single invalid support path or a single invalid generated continuation refutes the claimed guarantee.
constraints_not_enforced: Approximation quality to the original LLM beyond the validated HMM surrogate
Guarantees for logical constraints outside the tested formal representation
depends_on: Verify exact computation of the HMM constrained conditional probability distribution
experiment_recipes.rationale: A finite sample alone cannot prove a guarantee, so this combines empirical generation with a structural support check that invalid outputs have zero probability under the constrained HMM.

experiment_recipes.goal: Ablate the constraint-product mechanism to attribute satisfaction to HMM conditioning on the formal representation
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Run a matched-budget ablation using the same fitted HMM but removing the product with the formal constraint representation: sample from the unconstrained HMM, optionally applying only sample-and-select filtering with the same number of HMM next-token evaluations as the constrained sampler. Pass iff the full product-HMM sampler maintains 100% constraint satisfaction, while the ablated sampler produces at least one validator-rejected output in each tested non-trivial constraint family and has overall constraint satisfaction below 99%. If the ablated sampler also achieves 100% satisfaction, the result is not attributable to the claimed HMM-plus-formal-constraint mechanism.
constraints_not_enforced: Exact equivalence to the original LLM distribution
depends_on: Verify that generated HMM outputs are guaranteed to satisfy the formal constraints
experiment_recipes.rationale: This removes the claim's own mechanism, the formal conditioning/product construction, while keeping the HMM and sampling budget fixed; the comparison tests whether satisfaction is due to the proposed mechanism rather than easy prompts or the HMM prior.

experiment_recipes.goal: Stress-test robustness across constraint types, strengths, and unsatisfiable cases
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Evaluate the constrained HMM on a sweep of at least three constraint families: positive keyword inclusion, negative keyword exclusion, and positional/order constraints, with target lengths 8, 16, and 32, plus at least 50 deliberately unsatisfiable instances. Pass iff every satisfiable instance has positive constrained normalizer and 100% validator acceptance among generated outputs, and every unsatisfiable instance has zero constrained normalizer and the sampler refuses to emit a sequence. Any invalid output, false positive on an unsatisfiable constraint, or failure to return a valid sequence for a satisfiable constraint refutes robustness of the guarantee for the tested formal classes.
constraints_not_enforced: Logical constraints outside the tested positive, negative, positional, and grammar-style finite representations
depends_on: Verify exact computation of the HMM constrained conditional probability distribution
Verify that generated HMM outputs are guaranteed to satisfy the formal constraints
Ablate the constraint-product mechanism to attribute satisfaction to HMM conditioning on the formal representation
experiment_recipes.rationale: A robustness sweep checks that the guarantee is not limited to one easy constraint template and that the method fails safely when the formal language is empty.
